details.description: GPT-5.1-Codex is OpenAI's version of GPT-5.1 optimized for agentic coding tasks in Codex and similar harnesses, released November 13, 2025 alongside GPT-5.1. It is available only through OpenAI's Responses API, accepts text and image input with text-only output, supports configurable reasoning effort, and has a knowledge cutoff of September 30, 2024. OpenAI replaced it as Codex's default model with GPT-5.1-Codex-Max on November 19, 2025, though GPT-5.1-Codex remains generally available for agentic coding work.
advantages: OpenAI reports 73.7% on SWE-bench Verified (n=500) at high reasoning effort (OpenAI's GPT-5.1-Codex-Max launch post).
OpenAI reports 66.3% on SWE-Lancer IC SWE at high reasoning effort (OpenAI's GPT-5.1-Codex-Max launch post).
Purpose-trained for long-running, agentic coding tasks such as PR creation, code review and multi-file projects, unlike the general-purpose GPT-5.1 (OpenAI documentation).
Supports function calling and web search via the Responses API (OpenAI documentation).
disadvantages: Superseded as Codex's default model by GPT-5.1-Codex-Max on November 19, 2025, which OpenAI reports reaches a higher 77.9% on SWE-bench Verified while using 30% fewer thinking tokens at comparable effort (OpenAI launch post).
Available only through the Responses API, with no Chat Completions, Assistants, fine-tuning or Batch support (OpenAI documentation).

OpenAI's own direct API already shut down this exact model id on July 23, 2026, recommending gpt-5.6-sol; it remains generally available on Azure OpenAI, not expected to retire before May 15, 2027 (OpenAI deprecations page; Microsoft Foundry schedule).
use_cases: Long-running agentic coding tasks in the Codex CLI, IDE extension or cloud environments
Automated PR creation, code review and multi-file refactors
Coding agents that need apply_patch-based diffs and shell command execution

sources.title: Model retirement schedule - Microsoft Foundry | Microsoft Learn

notes: All of this target's URIs are Azure-hosted. Catalog's deprecation_date (2027-05-15) matches Microsoft Foundry's retirement-schedule listing for gpt-5.1-codex (version 2025-11-13, lifecycle 'GA', retirement date 2027-05-15) exactly. Separately, OpenAI's own direct-API deprecations page shows this same model id already shut down on July 23, 2026 (announced April 22, 2026) -- a real divergence between OpenAI-direct and Azure, though the Azure-hosted date the catalog uses is unaffected and still current as of this research date. Catalog's endpoints list only /v1/responses, matching OpenAI's own documentation exactly. The model's own 'Supported tools' listing (developers.openai.com) shows only function_calling and web_search for gpt-5.1-codex, and OpenAI's apply_patch tool guide names only GPT-5.1, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 as supported models (not the Codex variants), so an earlier draft's apply_patch/shell claim for this model was corrected.
